description_en: Deletes (recalls) a specific one-to-one chat message
description_zh: 调用DeleteLiveMessageUserMessage删除（撤回）某条单聊消息
name: DeleteLiveMessageUserMessage

parameters.help_en: The ID of the user who receives the delete message notification. The value consists of uppercase and lowercase letters and digits, and cannot exceed 64 bytes in length
parameters.help_zh: 接收删除消息的用户ID，由大小写字母、数字组成，长度不超过64字节
parameters.name: receiver_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the message to be deleted, which corresponds to the MsgTid in the send message operation. The value consists of uppercase and lowercase letters and digits, and cannot exceed 64 bytes in length
parameters.help_zh: 要删除的消息ID，与发送消息中的MsgTid对应。由大小写字母、数字组成，长度不超过64字节
parameters.name: message_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the user who initiates the message deletion. The value consists of uppercase and lowercase letters and digits, and cannot exceed 64 bytes in length. This parameter is required in practice. If not specified, InputInvalid is returned
parameters.help_zh: 发起删除消息的用户ID，由大小写字母、数字组成，长度不超过64字节。该参数实际为必填，不填时返回InputInvalid
parameters.name: deleter_id

parameters.help_en: The extended information of the user who initiates the message deletion. The value cannot exceed 512 bytes in length
parameters.help_zh: 发起删除消息的用户扩展信息，长度不超过512字节
parameters.name: deleter_info

parameters.help_en: The data center, which must be the same as the data center specified in https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848162.html. Currently, Shanghai (cn-shanghai) and Singapore (ap-southeast-1) are supported
parameters.help_zh: 数据中心，需要与https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848162.html中的数据中心一致, 当前支持上海（取值为cn-shanghai)、新加坡（取值为ap-southeast-1）
parameters.name: data_center
